author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸ್ವಪ್ರಶಂಸೆಯಿರೋ ಮನುಜ ತಾ ನಶಿಸುವನು
ಸ್ವಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠೆಯಲಿರೆ ಗೌರವವು ಸಿಗದು
ಸ್ವಪ್ರಕಟಿತನಾಗೆ ಗುಣಧರ್ಮವರಿತುನಡೆ
ಸುಪ್ರದೀಪಕನಾಗು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The man who praises himself will perish;
if you live on your own prestige, you won’t get respect;
to reveal yourself, know the dharma of virtue and walk by it;
become a bright lamp, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Self-praise and self-importance destroy respect. Let your character speak for itself, and you will shine like a lamp.
